gaps.sentence: The project's ___ (FAIL) was due to poor planning.
Last night's ___ (PERFORM) ended with a standing ovation.
gaps.explanation: 'Last night's performance' — the noun for the event.

gaps.sentence: She waited ___ (ANXIOUS) by the phone for news.
The dogs’ astonishing ___ (LOYAL) to their owners is well documented.
gaps.explanation: 'Astonishing loyalty' — the quality noun is required after the adjective.
'Studying management' — the field is called management.

gaps.sentence: He spoke ___ (CONFIDENT) in front of the camera.
The economy shows signs of ___ (RECOVER) after the recession.
